name: Outer Wilds clue dependency map
description: Prerequisite graph of the Outer Wilds base game (no DLC): what you must learn or reach before each step, where each clue is, alternative ways through, and how to get to key locations. Contains full spoilers.
sources: Quotes: official English and Simplified Chinese game text (Steam build, October 2026). Alternatives: Outer Wilds Wiki and community guides, cited per node.
how_to_read: player_action: realize = figure something out, explore = get somewhere or through something. Each node lists prerequisites (node ids that point into it). requires=all means every prerequisite is needed; requires=any means one is enough. type=alternative nodes are non-intended ways through (alternative_kind: official = another in-game clue or mechanic, luck = trial and error or brute force). location_ref points to a location node describing how to get there.

summary.zh: 可选
summary.en: Optional

summary.zh: 可选
summary.en: Optional

label.zh: 你被困在 22 分钟的循环里
label.en: You are stuck in a 22-minute loop

place.zh: 木炉星 · 天文台的挪麦雕像
place.en: Timber Hearth · the Nomai statue in the observatory

summary.zh: 雕像和你配对，每轮都带着记忆醒来
summary.en: The statue paired with you; you keep your memories

notes.zh: 第一次死亡或看到超新星后，你会在营火边重新醒来。原因是天文台的挪麦雕像睁眼和你配对了，之后每一轮你都带着记忆回来。
notes.en: After your first death or supernova you wake at the campfire again: the observatory’s Nomai statue opened its eyes and paired with you, so you keep your memories every loop.

quotes.en: The Nomai statue in the observatory opened its eyes and looked at me! I saw strange glowing lights and my own memories flashed before my eyes.
quotes.zh: 天文台里的那座挪麦雕像睁开了眼睛，还盯着我看！我看见了奇怪的光芒，我的回忆在眼前闪过。

label.en: Get the launch codes and lift off

place.zh: 木炉星 · 天文台的霍恩费斯
place.en: Timber Hearth · Hornfels at the observatory

notes.zh: 一切的起点。去天文台找霍恩费斯拿发射密码，才能坐升降梯上发射台。
notes.en: Where it all starts: Hornfels at the observatory gives you the launch codes for the launch tower lift.

quotes.en: Here they are. Best get off the ground before Slate makes any more modifications to your ship, eh?
quotes.zh: 在这儿呢。我们最好在斯雷特对宇宙飞船做出任何调整之前赶紧升空，怎么样？

label.zh: 损伤报告：跟踪模块遗失

place.zh: 轨道探测炮 · 控制模块

quotes.en: Probe Tracking Module: MISSING.
quotes.zh: 探测器跟踪模块：遗失。

label.zh: 有部件沉到了水流下面
label.en: A part sank below the current

place.zh: 碎空星南部天文台 / 建造厂

quotes.en: The Nomai on the Construction Yard saw something sink beneath the underwater current, which they'd previously thought was impossible.
quotes.zh: 建造厂的挪麦人看见有东西沉到了水流的下面。在此之前，他们觉得这种事情是不可能的。

place.zh: 深巨星 · 荆棘岛上他的旧营地
place.en: Giant’s Deep · his old camp on Bramble Island

quotes.en: Feldspar found a way to reach the core of Giant’s Deep.
quotes.zh: 费尔德斯巴找到了抵达深巨星核心的方法。

notes.zh: 先得知道坐标在海底，才会去想办法下潜。
notes.en: You have to know the coordinates are underwater before you look for a way down.

place.zh: 碎空星 · 南部天文台的气旋模型
place.en: Brittle Hollow · cyclone model in the Southern Observatory

quotes.en: There also exists a rarer type of cyclone that spins the opposite direction and pushes objects beneath the waters and below the current.
quotes.zh: 还有一种较为罕见的气旋，会反方向旋转，把对象往水面和水流下方推。

label.zh: 碰巧被逆时针气旋卷下去

summary.zh: 费尔德斯巴就是这么发现的
summary.en: That is how Feldspar found it

notes.zh: 费尔德斯巴自己就是这么发现的。
notes.en: That is how Feldspar found it.

quotes.en: I found that bit out by accident, but let’s keep that between you and me, hey? Hornfels would have my very handsome head if they knew I’d been riding the cyclones again.
quotes.zh: 我是无意间才发现的，不过这事咱们就别告诉其他人了，行吗？要是让霍恩费斯知道我又搭气旋的便车，他非把我的皮给扒了不可。

label.en: Dive in at very high speed

summary.zh: 约每秒一万米，撞上岛就会死
summary.en: About 10 km/s; hit an island and you die

notes.zh: 速度够快（每秒约一万米）可以直接冲破水流，撞上岛就会死。有对应的成就。
notes.en: Fast enough (around 10 km/s) and you punch straight through; hit an island and you die. There is an achievement for it.

summary.zh: 岛砸回海面时把飞船压下去
summary.en: The island slams back down and pushes you under

notes.zh: 岛被气旋抛上天再砸回海面时，有时会把下面的飞船压到水流以下。
notes.en: When a cyclone throws an island and it crashes back down, it can push a ship underneath below the current.

label.zh: 用重力炮把航天飞机打过去
label.en: Fire the Nomai shuttle at it

place.zh: 碎空星重力炮 → 深巨星
place.en: Brittle Hollow gravity cannon → Giant’s Deep

summary.zh: 能过水流，过不了电场
summary.en: Gets past the current, not the field

notes.zh: 两颗星靠近时，用碎空星重力炮发射所莱内姆的航天飞机，能穿过水流，但穿不过核心外的电场。前提是已经把它从量子卫星召回来。
notes.en: Launch Solanum’s shuttle from the Brittle Hollow gravity cannon when the planets are close. It gets below the current but not through the electric field. You need to have recalled it from the Quantum Moon first.

place.zh: 深巨星海面下的强水流
place.en: The strong current under the ocean

summary.zh: 强水流让任何东西都沉不下去
summary.en: A strong current keeps everything afloat

notes.zh: 深巨星海面下有一层强水流，正常情况下任何东西都沉不下去。
notes.en: A strong current under the surface of Giant’s Deep keeps everything from sinking.

quotes.en: Gabbro says there’s a strong current beneath the surface of the ocean that prevents anything from sinking below it.
quotes.zh: 加布罗说水面下有一股很强劲的水流，使得水里的东西无法沉下去。

place.zh: 信号镜 · 旅行者频道

quotes.en: Esker's signalscope log reports harmonica music coming from somewhere on Timber Hearth. They claim it sounds just like Feldspar's harmonica, but Feldspar disappeared in space ages ago.
quotes.zh: 埃斯科的信号镜日志报告说，木炉星的某处传来了口琴声。他说那声音听起来和费尔德斯巴的口琴一模一样。可是费尔德斯巴早就消失在太空里了。

label.zh: 侦察兵射进木炉星的种子

summary.zh: 侦察兵出现在满是雾和藤的大空间
summary.en: The scout ends up in a vast space of fog and vines

quotes.en: When I launch my scout into the seed that crashed on Timber Hearth, it ends up in a much bigger space filled with fog and thorny vines.
quotes.zh: 当我把侦查兵发射到坠落在木炉星的种子里面去的时候，它最后却出现在了一个充满雾气和尖刺藤蔓的更大的空间。

summary.zh: 他去黑棘星前在这里扎过营
summary.en: He camped here before heading to Dark Bramble

quotes.en: An island of thorny vines and what appears to be a frozen jellyfish. It looks like Feldspar camped here before heading off to Dark Bramble.
quotes.zh: 一座长满了有刺藤蔓的岛屿，样子像是一只冻住的水母。看起来费尔德斯巴在前往黑棘星之前曾经在这里扎营。

label.en: Stumble on him in Dark Bramble

place.en: Inside one of Dark Bramble’s seeds

label.en: Anglerfish are blind and hunt by sound

place.zh: 余烬双星 · 安康鱼化石

summary.zh: 关掉引擎，靠惯性滑过去
summary.en: Cut the engines and drift

notes.zh: 关掉引擎靠惯性滑过去，安康鱼就发现不了你。
notes.en: Cut the engines and drift; they won’t notice you.

quotes.en: The blindfold rule was added because real anglerfish are blind.
quotes.zh: 之所以加入眼罩这个规则，是因为真正的安康鱼就是看不见的。

label.en: Do nothing after entering a seed

summary.zh: 出种子时速度方向固定，直接漂
summary.en: Seeds launch you at a fixed speed — just drift

notes.zh: 从种子出来时速度和方向是固定的，什么都不按就能稳定漂过去；转动机身不会惊动它们。
notes.en: You always come out of a seed at a fixed speed and heading, so doing nothing drifts you past reliably. Rotating the ship doesn’t alert them.

label.zh: 全速甩开，或让它卡在藤蔓间
label.en: Outrun them or snag them on vines

summary.zh: 入口中枢 1 条，鱼巢 5 条
summary.en: One in the hub, five in the nest

notes.zh: 飞船线和水母线都要穿过黑棘星：入口的中枢里就有一条，飞船所在的种子更是在有五条安康鱼的鱼巢里。
notes.en: Both the Vessel line and the jellyfish line run through Dark Bramble: one waits in the hub you enter first, and the Vessel’s seed sits in the nest guarded by five.

place.zh: 黑棘星南极外壳 · 空心藤尽头的冻水母
place.en: Dark Bramble’s south pole crust · frozen jellyfish at the end of the hollow vine

summary.zh: 钻进水母体内，随它穿过电场
summary.en: Ride inside a jellyfish through the field

notes.zh: 问费尔德斯巴怎么去深巨星核心，他不直说，只让你去他飞船撞上的那根空心藤尽头看看。藤通到黑棘星外壳的一道裂缝，里面冻着一只水母和他的笔记。钻进深巨星的水母体内，就能随它穿过电场。
notes.en: Ask Feldspar how to reach Giant’s Deep’s core and he only tells you to see where the hollow vine his ship hit ends. It leads to a crack in Dark Bramble’s outer crust with a frozen jellyfish and his notes. Get inside a Giant’s Deep jellyfish and ride it through the field.

quotes.en: Feldspar hinted that a secret to reaching the core of Giant's Deep lies at the end of the hollow vine they crashed their ship into. To find Feldspar's ship, I'll want to go to the tail end of the anglerfish skeleton and look for a flickering light in the fog.
quotes.zh: 费尔德斯巴提示说，抵达深巨星核心的秘密就藏在他的飞船坠毁的那棵空心藤蔓尽头里。我要去安康鱼骨架的尾巴那里，在迷雾里寻找闪烁的光亮，才能发现费尔德斯巴的飞船。

quotes.en: Feldspar documented their attempts to eat this enormous jellyfish frozen in the ice. The outside was all rubbery and tough, possibly because it insulates the jellyfish’s insides from getting zapped by electricity.
quotes.zh: 费尔德斯巴曾经多次尝试吃掉这条冰封起来的巨大水母，并把这些内容记录了下来。外皮就像橡胶，根本咬不动。可能是为了起到绝缘的作用，保护水母内部，以免触电。

quotes.en: After tasting the inside of the jellyfish, Feldspar concluded that these jellyfish are only useful for insulation from electricity.
quotes.zh: 品尝过水母的内部之后，费尔德斯巴得出了结论，这些水母只有在隔绝电流时才有用。

label.en: Find the frozen jellyfish from outside

place.zh: 黑棘星南极的外壳碎片

summary.zh: 不见费尔德斯巴也能找到那道裂缝
summary.en: Reach the crack without meeting Feldspar

notes.zh: 那道裂缝也能从黑棘星外面找到，不必先见费尔德斯巴。
notes.en: The crack can also be found from outside Dark Bramble, without meeting Feldspar first.

quotes.en: The ocean is surprisingly calm beneath the current. Some sort of electrical field surrounds the planet's core.
quotes.zh: 水流下面的海洋出奇地宁静。某种电场环绕着行星的核心。

place.zh: 深巨星核心 · 探测器跟踪模块
place.en: Giant’s Deep core · Probe Tracking Module

summary.zh: 第 9,318,054 号探测器找到，存在投影池里
summary.en: Found by probe 9,318,054, kept in its projection pool

notes.zh: 跟踪模块从轨道探测炮上脱落，沉进了深巨星核心。它的投影池里存着第 9,318,054 号探测器找到的宇宙之眼坐标。
notes.en: The tracking module broke off the Orbital Probe Cannon and sank to the core of Giant’s Deep. Its projection pool holds the coordinates found by probe 9,318,054.

quotes.en: The 9,318,054th probe located a deep space anomaly matching all known criteria for the Eye of the universe.
quotes.zh: 探测器9,318,054发现了与宇宙之眼所有已知指标相符的深空异常现象。

summary.zh: 遇到信号 → 被黑棘星缠住 → 放出逃生舱
summary.en: Signal → caught by Dark Bramble → pods launched

quotes.en: A mural of Dark Bramble ensnaring the Nomai vessel.
quotes.zh: 一幅黑棘星缠住挪麦飞船的壁画。

place.zh: 碎空星 / 余烬双星的逃生舱
place.en: Escape pods on Brittle Hollow / Ember Twin

summary.zh: 三个逃生舱都来自一艘叫"飞船"的大船
summary.en: All three pods came from the Vessel

quotes.en: All three escape pods were launched from something called the Vessel, which was badly damaged.
quotes.zh: 所有三个逃生舱都是从某个损坏严重、名叫飞船的东西发射出来的。

place.zh: 顺着信号镜的求救信号找到
place.en: Found by its distress signal on the signalscope

summary.zh: 两个一样的信标；顺着灯走到坟墓
summary.en: Two identical beacons; follow the lights to the grave

notes.zh: 找到碎空星或余烬双星的逃生舱后，信号镜会多出"求救信号"频道，黑棘星里有一颗种子正发着这个信号。舱里的人测到两个一模一样的飞船信标，跟着近的那个走，沿途留下一串灯，最后死在小种子前。顺着灯就能找到坟墓。
notes.en: After you find the escape pod on Brittle Hollow or Ember Twin, your signalscope picks up the distress frequency, and one seed in Dark Bramble is sending it. The survivors heard two identical Vessel beacons, followed the nearer one leaving a trail of lights, and died at a small seed. Follow the lights to the grave.

quotes.en: The survivors from Escape Pod 3 detected two distinct beacons from the Vessel, as if it was in two locations at once.
quotes.zh: 3号逃生舱的幸存者检测到了从飞船发出的两个不同信标，好像飞船同时出现在了两个地方一样。

label.zh: 侦察兵射进坟墓的小种子
label.en: Fire the scout into the grave’s small seed

summary.zh: 种子太小，只有侦察兵进得去
summary.en: Too small for anything but your scout

quotes.en: If I launch my scout into the seed, I can take photos of an enormous derelict Nomai ship.
quotes.zh: 如果我把侦查兵发射到种子里面去，我就可以拍下那艘被挪麦人废弃的巨大飞船的照片。

label.zh: 费尔德斯巴：这里的空间不正常

place.zh: 黑棘星 · 费尔德斯巴的营地

summary.zh: 侦察兵同时在两个地方，并没有错
summary.en: The scout really can be in two places

quotes.en: Feldspar doesn't think my scout tracker is wrong when it says my scout is in two places at once. They have a theory that space doesn’t work the same inside Dark Bramble.
quotes.zh: 我的侦查跟踪器说，侦查兵同时出现在了两个地方。而费尔德斯巴认为跟踪器说得没错。他得出了一个理论，认为那里的空间和黑棘星内部的空间是不一样的。

label.zh: 另一个入口在安康鱼巢里
label.en: The other way in is in the anglerfish nest

place.zh: 黑棘星 · 鱼巢里那颗不发光的种子
place.en: Dark Bramble · the unlit seed in the nest

summary.zh: 不发光的大种子，飞船从那里进
summary.en: An unlit, ship-sized seed — the way in

notes.zh: 坟墓那颗种子太小，只有侦察兵进得去。侦察兵进去后，追踪器显示它同时在两个地方：另一处是安康鱼巢里一颗不发光的大种子，飞船只能从那里进。这就是两个信标的真相。
notes.en: The grave seed only fits your scout. Once inside, the tracker shows the scout in two places at once; the other is an unlit, ship-sized seed in the anglerfish nest. That is the second beacon.

label.en: Search the seeds one by one

summary.zh: 鱼巢里唯一不发光的那颗
summary.en: The only unlit seed in the nest

notes.zh: 飞船所在的种子就在安康鱼巢里，是唯一不发光的那颗；巢里另外三颗通向一个死循环的空间。
notes.en: The Vessel’s seed is in the anglerfish nest — the only one that doesn’t glow; the other three lead to a space that loops back on itself.

summary.zh: 核心摔坏了，但存着宇宙之眼的原始信号
summary.en: Its core is broken, but it holds the Eye’s original signal

notes.zh: 飞船当年被黑棘星缠住，跃迁核心摔坏了，但还能接收消息，也存着宇宙之眼的原始信号。
notes.en: Dark Bramble caught the Vessel and broke its warp core, but it can still receive messages and holds the Eye’s original signal.

quotes.en: The Vessel's warp core broke when the ship crashed in Dark Bramble.
quotes.zh: 飞船坠毁在黑棘星上时，它的跃迁核心摔坏了。

place.zh: 高能实验室 / 矿井 / 雕塑车间 / 黑洞熔炉
place.en: High Energy Lab / mines / Statue Workshop / Black Hole Forge

summary.zh: 实验室选址、矿井造壳、熔炉铸核心
summary.en: Lab chose the site, mines built the shell, forge cast the core

notes.zh: 高能实验室提议选址灰烬双星；木炉星矿井在造它的保护壳；雕塑车间的面具装在里面；黑洞熔炉为它铸核心。
notes.en: The High Energy Lab proposed Ash Twin; Timber Hearth’s mines supplied its shell; the Statue Workshop’s masks are inside; the Black Hole Forge cast its core.

quotes.en: The Nomai wanted to know if a 22-minute negative time interval was possible. They concluded it would require new technology to produce the necessary energy as well as an advanced warp core to handle those energies. Ash Twin was proposed as a location for the project.
quotes.zh: 挪麦人想知道，他们是否能够制造出一个22分钟的时间倒流间隔。他们得出结论，实现这一目标需要一种能够产生必要能量的新技术，还需要一颗能够处理这些能量的高级跃迁核心。他们提议将灰烬双星作为该计划的选址。

label.en: The project is inside Ash Twin
The shell has no physical entrance

summary.zh: 保护壳完工后检查过：没有入口
summary.en: Checked after sealing: no way in

quotes.en: Once the shell was finished, the Nomai checked to ensure there were no longer any physical entrances or cracks.
quotes.zh: 保护外壳一经完成，挪麦人便对其进行检查，确认其上没有裂缝，也没有任何与内部物理接触的方式。

label.en: Fly there and find no way in
Fall into Brittle Hollow’s black hole

summary.zh: 掉进去的东西从白洞出来
summary.en: What falls in comes out of the white hole

notes.zh: 碎空星的地壳一直在碎，掉进中心黑洞的东西会从白洞出来，白洞站就在旁边。
notes.en: Brittle Hollow’s crust keeps breaking up; whatever falls into the central black hole comes out of the white hole, next to the station.

quotes.en: There is a White Hole Station on the other side of Brittle Hollow's black hole.
quotes.zh: 碎空星黑洞的另一边有一个白洞站。

label.zh: 站上平台，等目标过头顶
label.en: Stand on the pad until the target is overhead

quotes.en: To use a tower, you must be standing on the warp platform during the tower's alignment with its corresponding astral body (the alignment happens when the astral body is directly overhead).
quotes.zh: 要使用跃迁塔，你必须站在跃迁平台上，等待跃迁塔与其对应的天体匹配（对应天体经过头顶正上方时，匹配就会完成）。

summary.zh: 偏差五度以内都算对准
summary.en: Within five degrees counts as aligned

quotes.en: Anyone stepping onto the warp platform during the active window will be immediately warped.
quotes.zh: 在有效时间内踏上跃迁平台的任何人都会立即跃迁。

place.zh: 余烬双星 · 高能实验室

summary.zh: 每座塔的样子对应它的目的地
summary.en: Each tower looks like where it goes

quotes.en: Each tower was designed to visually reflect its warp destination.
quotes.zh: 每座高塔的外观都设计成了对应跃迁目的地的风格。
quotes.source: Ship log · Ash Twin Tower Designs

quotes.en: POKE: The tower designs in the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin reveal each receiver's location. Ask Yarrow; he is familiar with them.
quotes.zh: 珀克：余烬双星上的高能实验室中的高塔设计图可以显示每个接收点的位置。去问亚罗吧，他对这些很熟悉。

label.en: The twins share an alignment point

summary.zh: 亚罗以为有座塔永远对不上
summary.en: Yarrow thought one tower could never align

quotes.en: POKE: Of note: Yarrow believes he spotted a flaw in the warp tower designs: namely, that one of the warp towers on Ash Twin will never activate, because its warp receiver will never align overhead.
quotes.zh: 珀克：注意事项：亚罗相信自己发现了跃迁塔设计图上的一处缺陷：灰烬双星上的一座跃迁塔无法激活，因为它的跃迁接收点无法对准正上方。

quotes.en: The Hourglass Twins are so close together they function as a single astral body, with a shared alignment point in between them.
quotes.zh: 沙漏双星离得特别近，就像一个天体一样，它们共用的对准点就在双星之间。

label.zh: 推理：余烬双星到头顶时它就启动
label.en: Deduce: it fires when Ember Twin is overhead

summary.zh: 这座塔的接收点在星球中心
summary.en: Its receiver is at the planet’s center

notes.zh: 赤道那圈塔各通一处，样子对应目的地。有一座塔看起来永远对不上，因为它的接收点就在灰烬双星中心。按熔炉的规则，沙漏双星共用两星之间的对准点：站在这座塔里的平台上，等余烬双星经过头顶，就会被传进计划。
notes.en: Each tower on the equator leads somewhere and looks like its destination. One seems like it could never align, because its receiver is inside Ash Twin itself. By the Forge’s rule the twins share an alignment point between them: stand on the pad inside that tower and wait for Ember Twin to pass overhead.

label.zh: 正确的塔外有挪麦遗体
label.en: A Nomai body lies outside the right tower

summary.zh: 塔门口的标记
summary.en: A marker at the door

notes.zh: 通往计划的那座塔门口躺着一具挪麦遗体，可以当作认塔的标记。
notes.en: A Nomai body lies at the door of the tower that leads into the project — a marker for the right one.

label.zh: 把每座塔的平台挨个试

label.en: The tower that leads into the project

place.zh: 灰烬双星赤道 · 一对用桥相连的塔
place.en: Ash Twin’s equator · a pair of towers joined by a bridge

summary.zh: 站进塔里的平台
summary.en: Stand on the pad inside

label.en: Sand flows from Ash Twin to Ember Twin

summary.zh: 约第 7 分 50 秒起能站进塔里
summary.en: From about 7:50 you can stand inside

notes.zh: 这座塔一开始埋在沙里，大约第 7 分 50 秒才露出足够的空间站上塔里的平台。塔顶有破口，小心被落沙冲走。
notes.en: The tower starts buried; from about 7:50 enough of it is clear to stand on the pad inside. Mind the sand pouring through its broken roof.

label.en: Doze at a campfire to skip ahead

summary.zh: 拿到发射密码后可用
summary.en: Available after the launch codes

notes.zh: 拿到发射密码后，就可以在营火边打盹跳过一段时间。
notes.en: Once you have the launch codes you can doze at a campfire to skip time.

label.en: Wait for the sand to clear the tower

place.zh: 灰烬双星 · 中央舱室

summary.zh: 计划的动力源，取下循环就停
summary.en: Powers the project; taking it stops the loop

notes.zh: 灰烬双星计划的核心。飞船原来的核心坏了，只有这一颗能带它跃迁。
notes.en: The core that powers the Ash Twin Project. The Vessel’s own core is broken; this is the only one that can make it warp.

quotes.en: There is an advanced warp core inside the protective casing at the center of the planet. Removing the core will disable the Ash Twin Project.
quotes.zh: 行星中央的保护外壳内部有一颗高级跃迁核心。移除核心将会关闭灰烬双星计划。

label.zh: 飞船的跃迁核心早已失灵
label.en: The Vessel’s warp core is long dead

quotes.en: The Vessel's warp core is long dead.
quotes.zh: 飞船的跃迁核心早已失灵。

label.zh: 舰桥的三面柱能输入坐标

quotes.en: I activated a three-sided pillar on the Vessel's bridge that appears to be some sort of input device.
quotes.zh: 我启动了飞船舰桥上的一根三面柱。它看上去像是某种输入装置。

label.zh: 计划中心的核心可以取下
label.en: The project’s core can be removed

place.zh: 灰烬双星计划 · 中央

quotes.en: WARNING: Removing the core will disable the Ash Twin Project.
quotes.zh: 警告：移除核心将会关闭灰烬双星计划。

label.zh: 把计划的核心装进飞船
label.en: Put the project’s core into the Vessel

summary.zh: 取下核心循环就停，要同一轮带到飞船
summary.en: It stops the loop — deliver it in the same loop

notes.zh: 最后的顿悟：飞船缺一颗核心，计划里正好有一颗。取下它，循环就停了，所以要在同一轮里把核心带进黑棘星。
notes.en: The last realization: the Vessel is missing a core and the project has one. Taking it stops the loop, so you have to carry it into Dark Bramble in that same loop.

label.en: Warp to the Eye of the Universe

place.zh: 黑棘星深处 · 挪麦飞船舰桥
place.en: Deep in Dark Bramble · the Vessel’s bridge

summary.zh: 装好核心、输入坐标、跃迁
summary.en: Fit the core, enter the coordinates, warp

notes.zh: 把高级跃迁核心装进飞船，在舰桥的三面柱上输入坐标，飞船就会跃迁到宇宙之眼。
notes.en: Install the advanced warp core in the Vessel, enter the coordinates on the three-sided pillar on the bridge, and the Vessel warps to the Eye.

notes.zh: 取出核心的同时时间循环就停了，所以这一步只能放在最后一轮。
notes.en: Taking the core out stops the time loop, so this has to be your last loop.

quotes.en: I found a recording of the original signal the Nomai encountered from the Eye of the universe. The Nomai were worried the signal might disappear, so they warped before they could tell another clan where they were going.
quotes.zh: 我找到了一份记录，上面是挪麦人从宇宙之眼那里收到的原始信号。挪麦人担心信号会消失，那个信号是从某个比宇宙还要古老的地方发出来的因此他们还没有来得及告诉其它家族自己要去哪里，就跃迁走了。

label.en: The front door is locked from inside

quotes.en: The High Energy Lab can only be accessed by a path from the Sunless City.
quotes.zh: 只能从背阴城的一条道路才能抵达高能实验室。

label.zh: 切特：地表几乎没有废墟
label.en: Chert: hardly any ruins on the surface

place.zh: 余烬双星 · 切特的营地

quotes.en: Chert thinks the lack of surface ruins means the Nomai must have lived somewhere underground.
quotes.zh: 切特觉得地表很少有废墟这个事实，说明挪麦人一定住在地下的什么地方。

label.zh: 幸存者躲进了逃生舱下的洞

quotes.en: The Nomai survivors who crashed on Ember Twin decided to seek shelter in the caves beneath their crashed escape pod.
quotes.zh: 在余烬双星上失事的挪麦幸存者们决定在坠毁逃生舱下面的洞窟里需求庇护所。

summary.zh: 切特看见南半球有光束射向天空
summary.en: Chert saw a beam of light in the south

quotes.en: Chert saw a Nomai shipwreck shooting a beam of light into the sky somewhere on Ember Twin's southern hemisphere.
quotes.zh: 切特看见一艘挪麦宇宙飞船残骸向余烬双星南半球的某个地方发射了一道光束。

label.zh: 从2号逃生舱下的洞穴跟着路标走
label.en: Follow the markers from under Escape Pod 2

summary.zh: 洞里漆黑，墙上有挪麦路标
summary.en: Dark maze; the Nomai marked the walls

notes.zh: 洞里漆黑，像迷宫，挪麦人在墙上留了路标。
notes.en: The caves are dark and maze-like; the Nomai marked the walls.

quotes.en: ANNONA: Even with this danger, they are still our best chance for survival. We’ll form teams and descend into the caves to look for a shelter site. We can mark our findings on the walls to avoid becoming irreversibly lost.
quotes.zh: 安诺纳：虽然有这种危险存在，但假如我们想要活下去，这是最好的办法。我们会组织队伍，向下深入洞窟，去寻找建立庇护所的位置。我们可以把发现的内容刻在墙上，以免彻底迷路。

label.zh: 重力炮上方的隐藏洞口
label.en: A hidden hole above the gravity cannon

place.zh: 余烬双星赤道 · 重力炮

summary.zh: 通到城顶；旁边的城门被仙人掌堵着
summary.en: Leads to the top; the nearby door is blocked by cacti

notes.zh: 通到城顶的宇宙之眼祭坛区，沿途有幽灵物质和仙人掌。重力炮旁边那扇城门被仙人掌堵着。
notes.en: Leads to the Eye Shrine District at the top of the city, past ghost matter and cacti. The door next to the cannon is blocked by cacti.

quotes.en: I found a trailmarker for the the Sunless City, but the path is blocked.
quotes.zh: 我找到了背阴城的路标，但是路被堵死了。

place.zh: 沙子从下往上灌满城市
place.en: Sand fills the city from the bottom up

notes.zh: 沙子会从下往上灌满整座城，晚了下层就进不去，回头路也常被沙瀑截断。
notes.en: Sand floods the city from the bottom up; later in the loop the lower districts close off and sandfalls cut off the way back.

label.zh: 沿能量电缆走城底的小路
label.en: Follow the power cable from the bottom of the city

summary.zh: 最后坐重力升降机穿过峡谷桥
summary.en: Ends with a gravity lift through the canyon bridge

notes.zh: 小路从背阴城最底层出发，沿一路延伸的能量电缆走，最后坐重力升降机、穿过峡谷桥内部进入实验室。
notes.en: The trail starts in the lowest district and follows the long power cable to a gravity lift, then through the inside of the canyon bridge into the lab.

label.en: Time it for the middle of the loop

place.en: Early half floods; later half needs sand

notes.zh: 小路前半段很快会被沙子淹没；后半段一开始有沙瀑把人冲进仙人掌丛，喷气背包过不去，要等沙子把仙人掌盖住才能走。
notes.en: The first half floods early. The second half starts with a sandfall pushing you into cacti — the jetpack won’t get you past — so wait for the sand to bury the cacti.

label.en: Light up the fossil’s mouth first

summary.zh: 往化石嘴里射侦察兵当灯
summary.en: Shoot your scout into its mouth as a lamp

notes.zh: 往化石嘴里射侦察兵当灯，入口就显出来了。
notes.en: Shoot your scout into the fossil’s mouth as a lamp and the entrance shows.

quotes.en: The entrance from Stepping Stone Cave is hard to see unless the anglerfish is fed a light first.
quotes.zh: 垫脚石洞的入口很难发现，除非先把一道光喂给安康鱼吃。

label.en: The crack in Stepping Stone Cave’s ceiling

quotes.en: Nomai children used to play a game in Fossil Fish Cave. There is a way to enter Fossil Fish Cave from Stepping Stone Cave.
quotes.zh: 挪麦人的孩子们以前在化石鱼洞里面玩游戏。有条路可以从垫脚石洞进入化石鱼洞。

summary.zh: 别的开口只能看，进不去
summary.en: Other openings only let you look

notes.zh: 从别的开口只能看到化石，进不去。
notes.en: Other openings only let you look in.

quotes.en: I found a cave with an anglerfish fossil inside, but the opening is only big enough for my scout.
quotes.zh: 我找到了一座山洞，里面有一副安康鱼的化石。但是开口太小，只有我的侦查兵才能进去。

label.en: Go in the first few minutes

summary.zh: 开局几分钟就被沙填满
summary.en: Fills with sand within minutes

notes.zh: 洞穴在循环开始后几分钟内就会被沙子填满，要第一时间赶过去。
notes.en: The cave fills with sand within the first few minutes, so go there first.

place.zh: 余烬双星北极的干湖底
place.en: Dry lakebed at Ember Twin’s north pole

quotes.en: The wandering rock was first spotted in a cave at the bottom of the dry lakebed at Ember Twin’s north pole.
quotes.zh: 有人第一次目击流浪岩石，是在余烬双星北极干涸湖床底部的一个洞穴里。

summary.zh: 背阴城的挪麦人说造了更安全的路
summary.en: Nomai in the city mention a safer way

quotes.en: Who’s been computing shuttle trajectories to the Sun Station? Don’t worry; the station is in such a low stellar orbit, we’ve constructed a different, safer way to travel there from Ash Twin.
quotes.zh: 是谁在一直计算航天飞机飞往太阳站的轨道？别担心；太阳站所处的恒星轨道非常低。我们已经实现了另一种更加安全的方法，可以从灰烬双星前往那里。

label.zh: 约第 5 分钟塔门露出
label.en: The tower door clears around minute 5

summary.zh: 有阳台的那侧，窗口很短；等太阳到头顶
summary.en: Balcony side, brief window; wait for the Sun overhead

notes.zh: 沙子大约第 5 分钟流过太阳站塔，带阳台那一侧的门露出来，窗口很短。进去后站在平台上，等太阳到头顶。
notes.en: Around minute 5 the sand passes the Sun Station tower and the balcony-side door opens up, briefly. Stand on the pad inside and wait for the Sun to be overhead.

label.zh: 走灰烬双星上的太阳站塔
label.en: Use the Sun Station tower on Ash Twin

summary.zh: 极难，成功有成就
summary.en: Very hard; there is an achievement

notes.zh: 太阳引力极强、太阳站又绕得飞快，非常难，成功了有成就。
notes.en: Brutal with the Sun’s gravity and the station’s fast orbit. There is an achievement for it.

label.zh: 瑞拜克营地北边有座大城
label.en: A huge city north of Riebeck’s camp

place.zh: 碎空星赤道 · 瑞拜克

quotes.en: There's a huge Nomai city just to the north of Riebeck's campsite.
quotes.zh: 瑞拜克营地的北方坐落着一座巨大的挪麦城市。

label.zh: 旧定居点的人搬去了冰川
label.en: The settlers moved to the glacier

quotes.en: The Nomai decided to migrate from the Old Settlement to the northern glacier. They used gravity crystals to craft a stable path beneath the surface.
quotes.zh: 挪麦人决定从旧定居点向北部冰川迁移。他们使用重力水晶在地下制造出了一条稳定的道路。

label.zh: 冰川河流尽头的隐藏洞
label.en: A hidden hole where the glacier river ends

summary.zh: 顺着瀑布下到融水区
summary.en: Ride the waterfall down to the Meltwater District

notes.zh: 河水灌进洞口成了瀑布，顺着下去就是融水区。北极那座大建筑里的升降梯是坏的。
notes.en: The river pours into it as a waterfall down to the Meltwater District. The lift in the big building up there is broken.

place.zh: 入口在赤道上长树的废墟里
place.en: Entrance: the ruin with trees on the equator

notes.zh: 赤道上瑞拜克营地对面有座长满树的废墟，里面的挪麦小路一直通到地壳下的十字路口。
notes.en: Across from Riebeck’s camp on the equator, a Nomai path inside a tree-grown ruin leads down to the Crossroads.

quotes.en: Riebeck discovered an old Nomai path near their campsite on the equator. The path starts inside the ruined building with trees growing out of it.
quotes.zh: 瑞拜克在赤道营地附近发现了一条古老的挪麦道路。道路从树木丛生的废墟建筑里延伸了出去。

label.en: Cross the bridges from the Crossroads

summary.zh: 桥会被火山弹砸断
summary.en: Volcanic bombs break the bridges

notes.zh: 两座桥会被空心灯的火山弹陆续砸断，越晚越难走。
notes.en: Hollow’s Lantern’s volcanic bombs knock sections out over the loop.

label.zh: 打开1号逃生舱舱门，沿栈桥下去
label.en: Open Escape Pod 1’s hatch and climb down

summary.zh: 栈桥一踩就塌，掉下去就进黑洞
summary.en: The bridges crumble into the black hole

notes.zh: 木栈桥和台阶很脆，一踩就塌，掉下去就进黑洞。
notes.en: The wooden bridges and stairs are fragile; fall and you are in the black hole.

quotes.en: The Nomai survivors who crashed on Brittle Hollow climbed down the cliff to a shelter site below the surface.
quotes.zh: 坠毁在碎空星的挪麦幸存者们爬下悬崖，来到了地表下的一处庇护所。

place.en: Under the crust at Brittle Hollow’s equator

summary.zh: 重力水晶小路通到悬空城底层
summary.en: A crystal path leads to the city’s bottom

notes.zh: 从旧定居点有一条重力水晶小路沿地壳背面通到悬空城最底层的学校区。
notes.en: A gravity crystal path runs along the underside of the crust from here to the Hanging City’s School District.

label.zh: 在融水区把熔炉升上来
label.en: Raise the forge from the Meltwater District

summary.zh: 平时降在黑洞旁，升上来才进得去
summary.en: Normally hangs down by the black hole

notes.zh: 熔炉平时降在星球中心的黑洞旁边，只有升到悬空城最上层才进得去。
notes.en: The forge normally hangs down by the black hole; you can only enter it once it is raised to the top of the city.

quotes.en: The Black Hole Forge is suspended below the Hanging City. I found a switch in the Meltwater District that raises and lowers the forge.
quotes.zh: 黑洞熔炉悬挂在悬空城的下方。我在融水区找到了一个可以升降熔炉的开关。

label.zh: 从灰烬双星的碎空星塔跃迁过来
label.en: Warp in from the Brittle Hollow tower on Ash Twin

summary.zh: 熔炉区里就有接收点
summary.en: Its receiver is in the Forge District

notes.zh: 熔炉区里就有这座塔对应的接收点。
notes.en: That tower’s receiver is in the Forge District.

summary.zh: 通往最上层的竖井断了
summary.en: The shaft up is broken

notes.zh: 通往最上层的竖井断了，正常走不上去。
notes.en: The shaft up to the top district is broken.

place.zh: 碎空星南极 · 瑞拜克的飞船

quotes.en: Riebeck says you can't get into the observatory from the surface (they tried), but there's probably a path to it beneath the crust somewhere.
quotes.zh: 根据瑞拜克的说法，从地面进入天文台是不可能的（他试过了），不过地壳下某个地方可能有条通路。

summary.zh: 地面能走到，或从十字路口往东跳
summary.en: Walk there, or hop east from the Crossroads

notes.zh: 从地面能直接走到，也可以从十字路口往东跳过一串地壳碎块。
notes.en: You can walk there on the surface, or head east from the Crossroads across floating crust.

label.zh: 趁重力炮还没掉进黑洞

notes.zh: 重力炮在循环后期很可能随地壳掉进黑洞。
notes.en: Late in the loop the cannon is likely to fall into the black hole.

summary.zh: 在错位的重力电梯之间跳
summary.en: Jetpack between misaligned lifts

notes.zh: 一串错位的重力电梯和碎地壳，要用喷气背包在电梯之间跳。
notes.en: A run of misaligned gravity lifts and broken crust; jetpack between the lifts.

label.zh: 从量子知识之塔底层出发
label.en: Start at the base of the Tower of Quantum Knowledge
Take a path under the crust

quotes.en: There are two paths beneath Brittle Hollow's surface that lead to the observatory. One starts at the gravity cannon, and the other starts at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.
quotes.zh: 碎空星地下有两条通往天文台的路。一条起始于重力炮，另一条起始于量子知识之塔。

label.zh: 航天飞机旁的记录指路

summary.zh: 往西走到十字路口再过去
summary.en: West to the Crossroads, then on

quotes.en: BELLS: The tower is on the opposite side of Brittle Hollow. If you follow the path west to the Crossroads, you can reach the tower from there.
quotes.zh: 贝尔斯：量子知识之塔在碎空星的另一头。如果你沿着西边的路走到十字路口，就能从那儿前往量子知识之塔。

label.zh: 等塔掉进黑洞，在白洞那边进
label.en: Let it fall through, enter at the white hole

summary.zh: 上层入口断了，在零重力里飘进去
summary.en: Upper entrance broken; float in

notes.zh: 塔的上层入口断了。地壳崩塌时整座塔会掉进黑洞，从白洞出来后在零重力里就能进去。
notes.en: The way up is broken. When the crust collapses the whole tower falls into the black hole; once it comes out of the white hole you can float in.

label.en: Top of the Tower of Quantum Knowledge
A quantum signal on Giant’s Deep

quotes.en: The Nomai detected a Quantum signal coming from somewhere on Giant’s Deep.
quotes.zh: 挪麦人检测到从深巨星的某处传来了一个量子信号。
quotes.source: Ship log · Tower of Quantum Trials

label.en: Drop in from above the clouds
Come up from below the current
Get past the giant polar cyclone

summary.zh: 风墙飞不过去
summary.en: You can’t fly through the wind wall

notes.zh: 北极有一个不会移动的巨型气旋，风墙过不去。
notes.en: A permanent cyclone sits on the north pole and its wall can’t be flown through.

label.zh: 挪麦孩子说的危险小路
label.en: The risky route the Nomai children mentioned

quotes.en: Some Nomai children debated bypassing the Statue Workshop's door and sneaking inside via an alternate (more dangerous) route.
quotes.zh: 一些挪麦孩子曾经考虑过要不要绕过雕塑车间的大门，通过另一条路（更加危险）偷偷溜进去。

label.zh: 从岛底下的开口游进去
label.en: Swim in from under the island

summary.zh: 圆顶岛，车间绕着内侧一圈
summary.en: A dome; the workshop rings its inside

notes.zh: 雕像岛是个圆顶，车间绕着内侧一圈，正中间通着大海。
notes.en: The island is a dome; the workshop rings its inside, open to the sea in the middle.

quotes.en: I can see into a large cave from one of the ruins on top of the island. The bottom of the cave is filled with water.
quotes.zh: 从岛屿顶端的其中一个废墟上，我可以看到一个巨大的山洞内部。山洞的底部全是水。

quotes.en: I found a sign for a "Statue Workshop" next to a broken door that used to lead inside the island.
quotes.zh: 我在一扇破损的大门旁发现了一块牌子，上面写着“雕塑车间”。这扇门一度可以通往岛屿的内部。

notes.zh: 深巨星重力大，喷气背包够不着；气旋把岛抛上天时才上得去。
notes.en: Giant’s Deep’s gravity is too strong to jetpack up; you can reach it while a cyclone has the island in the air.

label.en: An entrance inside the biggest geyser mountain

quotes.zh: 挪麦人在木炉星的某处开采矿石。

label.zh: 它会在五个位置之间跳

place.zh: 余烬双星 · 量子卫星定位器

summary.zh: 守在某处等它，飞近时一直盯着
summary.en: Wait for it and keep watching as you approach

notes.zh: 知道它会在几颗行星之间跳，就能守着某处等它，飞近时一直盯着它。
notes.en: Knowing it hops between planets, you can wait for it somewhere and keep watching it as you approach.

quotes.en: The Quantum Moon travels to a total of five locations.
quotes.zh: 量子卫星一共会出现在五个位置。

label.en: Photograph it, then watch it as you land

notes.zh: 先给量子卫星拍张照，降落途中一直看着它，它就不会跳走。这本身就是成像法则的用法。
notes.en: Take a photo of the moon and keep looking at it as you descend so it can’t jump away — the rule of imaging at work.

place.en: You always land at the south pole

quotes.en: Visitors to the Quantum Moon always arrive at the south pole (for reasons unknown to the Nomai).
quotes.zh: 前往量子卫星的人总是会来到南极（挪麦人也不知道这是为什么）。

summary.zh: 塔里的谜题要靠拍照定住物体
summary.en: Its puzzles need photos to pin objects

notes.zh: 塔里的谜题本身就要用拍照来"定住"量子物体，过了关就学会了。
notes.en: The tower’s puzzles make you pin quantum objects with photos; finishing them teaches the rule.

quotes.en: "Observing a quantum object; observing an image of a quantum object. These are the same."
quotes.zh: “观察一个量子对象；观察一个量子对象的图形。它们是一样的事情。”
quotes.source: Ship log · Tower of Quantum Trials

label.zh: 自己试出拍照能定住它

notes.zh: 社区里有玩家完全靠试错摸出这条规则，属于个人说法。
notes.en: Some players say they worked it out by trial and error alone.

place.zh: 观察图像 = 观察本体
place.en: Observing an image = observing the object

place.zh: 余烬双星 · 湖床洞穴

summary.zh: 灯灭时站在石头上，人和石头一起消失
summary.en: Lights out on the rock, and both vanish

quotes.en: To travel with a quantum object, I must stand on the object and cease to observe my surroundings (meaning I must be in complete darkness). Coleus used this quantum rule to escape the cave he was trapped in.
quotes.zh: 我必须站在量子对象上，停止观察我的周围（也就是说我必须完全处于黑暗之中），才能和该对象一起移动。科利耶斯利用这条量子法则从被困的洞穴里逃了出来。

label.zh: 碎空星高塔碎片旁的文字
label.en: Text by Brittle Hollow’s tower shard

notes.zh: Wiki 说碎空星"高塔碎片"旁的挪麦文字也暗示了黑暗规则，我没逐条核对原文。
notes.en: The wiki says Nomai text by Brittle Hollow’s tower shard also hints at the darkness rule; I did not check it line by line.

label.zh: 站在量子碎片上关灯试试
label.en: Turn your light off on a shard

place.zh: 站在量子物体上，完全黑暗
place.en: Stand on it in complete darkness

quotes.en: BELLS: You’ll be aided in your pilgrimage by the shrine our clan built on the Quantum Moon. But remember this final rule: To explore the sixth location, the shrine must be on the moon’s north pole.
quotes.zh: 贝尔斯：我们家族建立在量子卫星上的祭坛将会协助你完成朝圣。但是，一定要记好这条最终的守则：要想探索第六个位置，祭坛必须位于卫星的北极。

place.en: The shrine must be at the north pole

summary.zh: 在祭坛里关门关灯，随它移动
summary.en: Shut the door, lights off, travel with it

notes.zh: 实际操作要把三条法则合起来用：祭坛本身也是量子物体，没人看着时会换位置。在祭坛里关门关灯，就会随它移动，卫星跳到别的行星。有些行星版本的地形挡住了北极，要先换到能走到北极的版本，站在北极背对着等祭坛出现，再进祭坛关灯一次，就到第六个位置。
notes.en: In practice you combine all three rules. The shrine is quantum too and moves when unobserved. Close the door and turn off the light inside and you travel with it as the moon jumps planets. Some versions block the north pole, so switch to one where you can walk there, stand at the pole facing away until the shrine appears, then use it once more.

notes.zh: 祭坛不在北极时，它的门会被碎石挡住。（步骤整理自 Wiki 和社区讨论）
notes.en: Anywhere but the pole, rock blocks the shrine’s door. (Steps from the wiki and community.)

quotes.zh: 冻结在闯入者上的挪麦航天飞机可以被召回到余烬双星的重力炮那里去。

quotes.zh: 太阳站失败后，挪麦人稍事休息，对刚抵达的彗星展开了调查。

label.en: The Nomai went to the comet

summary.zh: 一人留守保温，两人下去探索
summary.en: One stayed to keep warm, two went in

quotes.en: There were three Nomai aboard the shuttle. One of them stayed behind to keep the shuttle warm while the other two explored the Interloper.
quotes.zh: 航天飞机上载着三个挪麦人。其中一个留了下来，保障航天飞机的温度。其他两个人则去探索闯入者。

label.zh: 等彗星靠近太阳、冰面融开
label.en: Wait for the ice to melt near the Sun

notes.zh: 向阳面的冰会随着接近太阳融开，自己观察也能找到入口。
notes.en: The sunward ice melts open as the comet nears the Sun; you can spot the entrance yourself.

place.en: A fissure on the sunward side

quotes.en: Two of the Nomai located a fissure in the ice on the Interloper’s sunward side. They descended inside to investigate.
quotes.zh: 两个挪麦人在闯入者向阳面的冰块里发现了一道沟壑。他们爬了进去，想要进行调查。

label.zh: 照片里能看见幽灵物质

quotes.en: DANGER! Inside this fence is a pocket of ghost matter - a strange and dangerous substance that’s invisible to the naked eyes. The good news is that you can detect ghost matter with a camera.
quotes.zh: 危险！这道栅栏后面有一团幽灵物质。它拥有奇怪的特性，并且冰冷异常，无法被肉眼观察到。好消息是，你可以通过摄像机来侦测到幽灵物质。

place.zh: 肉眼看不见的致命物质
place.en: Lethal and invisible to the eye

place.zh: 闯入者 · 破裂的核心

summary.zh: 核心破裂，幽灵物质一眨眼覆盖星系
summary.en: The core burst; ghost matter covered the system

quotes.en: They determined the exotic matter was both lethal and under extreme pressure. If the stone were to rupture, the exotic matter within would rapidly expand, completely blanketing the solar system almost instantaneously.
quotes.zh: 他们推断这种异常的物质不但致命，而且目前正处在极度高压之下。如果岩石裂开来，那么里面的异常物质便会迅速扩散，几乎一眨眼就可以覆盖这个太阳系。

question.zh: 《星际拓荒》要打出结局，需要凑齐哪几样东西？
question.en: What do you need to reach the ending of Outer Wilds?

answer.zh: 三样：宇宙之眼的坐标（在深巨星核心的探测器跟踪模块里）、挪麦人的飞船（困在黑棘星深处）、高级跃迁核心（在灰烬双星计划的中央舱室里）。把核心装进飞船，在舰桥输入坐标，就能跃迁到宇宙之眼。取出核心会让时间循环停止，所以这一步要放在最后。
answer.en: Three things: the Eye of the Universe’s coordinates (in the Probe Tracking Module at the core of Giant’s Deep), the Nomai Vessel (stuck deep in Dark Bramble), and the advanced warp core (in the central chamber of the Ash Twin Project). Put the core in the Vessel, enter the coordinates on the bridge, and warp to the Eye. Taking the core stops the time loop, so do it last.

question.zh: 飞船在黑棘星哪里，怎么进去？
question.en: Where is the Vessel in Dark Bramble and how do you get in?

answer.zh: 先用信号镜的求救信号频道找到3号逃生舱，顺着幸存者留下的灯走到挪麦坟墓。坟墓前那颗种子太小，只能射侦察兵进去；进去后追踪器显示侦察兵同时在两个地方，另一处就是安康鱼巢里一颗不发光的大种子。穿过鱼巢的安康鱼，从那颗种子进去就是飞船。
answer.en: Use the signalscope’s distress frequency to find Escape Pod 3 and follow the survivors’ lights to the Nomai Grave. The seed there only fits your scout; once inside, the tracker shows the scout in two places, and the other one is an unlit, ship-sized seed in the anglerfish nest. Slip past the anglerfish in the nest and take that seed to the Vessel.

question.zh: 黑棘星的安康鱼怎么躲？
question.en: How do you get past the anglerfish in Dark Bramble?

answer.zh: 安康鱼是瞎的，靠声音找猎物，关掉引擎靠惯性滑过去就不会被发现。线索在余烬双星的安康鱼化石：挪麦小孩玩"安康鱼和小鱼"时，扮安康鱼的要戴眼罩。从种子出来时速度方向固定，什么都不按直接漂也很稳。
answer.en: Anglerfish are blind and hunt by sound, so cut your engines and drift. The clue is the anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin, where Nomai children played a game in which the “anglerfish” wore a blindfold. You leave each seed at a fixed speed and heading, so simply drifting works well.

question.zh: 怎么潜到深巨星的水流下面、穿过核心外的电场？
question.en: How do you get below Giant’s Deep’s current and through the electric field?

answer.zh: 设计好的办法是坐逆时针旋转的气旋下去，线索在碎空星南部天文台的气旋模型。也能高速直冲，或停在被抛起的岛下面等它砸下来。核心外的电场只能钻进水母穿过，线索是黑棘星里费尔德斯巴吃水母的笔记：外皮像橡胶，能绝缘。
answer.en: The intended way is to ride a counterclockwise cyclone down; the clue is the cyclone model in Brittle Hollow’s Southern Observatory. A very fast dive or a falling island also works. The electric field around the core can only be crossed inside a jellyfish; Feldspar’s notes in Dark Bramble say their rubbery skin insulates them.

question.zh: 灰烬双星计划怎么进去？
question.en: How do you get into the Ash Twin Project?

answer.zh: 保护外壳没有任何物理入口，只能跃迁。白洞站教你跃迁平台的用法；高能实验室的高塔设计图对应每座塔的去向；黑洞熔炉说明沙漏双星共用两星之间的对准点。合起来就知道：灰烬双星赤道上有一座塔的接收点在星球中心，站在那座塔里的平台上，等余烬双星经过头顶就会被传进去。那座塔一开始埋在沙里，大约第 7 分 50 秒才进得去。
answer.en: Its shell has no physical entrance, so you have to warp. The White Hole Station teaches how warp pads work; the tower designs in the High Energy Lab show where each tower goes; the Black Hole Forge says the Hourglass Twins share one alignment point between them. Put together: one tower on Ash Twin’s equator has its receiver at the planet’s center — stand on the pad inside it and wait for Ember Twin to pass overhead. The tower is buried in sand until about 7:50 into the loop.

question.zh: 背阴城和高能实验室怎么进？
question.en: How do you get into the Sunless City and the High Energy Lab?

answer.zh: 背阴城在余烬双星地下：从2号逃生舱下的洞穴跟着墙上的路标走，或从重力炮上方的隐藏洞口下去，要趁沙子还没灌满。高能实验室正门从里面锁着，只能从背阴城最底层沿能量电缆的小路过去，前半段怕沙子淹，后半段要等沙子盖住仙人掌。
answer.en: The Sunless City is beneath Ember Twin: follow the wall markers from the caves under Escape Pod 2, or drop through a hidden hole above the gravity cannon, before the sand fills it. The High Energy Lab’s front door is locked from inside; take the trail along the power cable from the city’s lowest district, early enough that the first half isn’t flooded and late enough that sand has buried the cacti on the second half.

question.zh: 黑洞熔炉和南部天文台怎么去？
question.en: How do you reach the Black Hole Forge and the Southern Observatory?

answer.zh: 黑洞熔炉挂在悬空城下面，先在融水区的控制室把它升到最上层，再从灰烬双星上的碎空星塔跃迁到熔炉区（竖井断了）。南部天文台的地面大门是坏的，要从地壳下走：从重力炮出发跳一串重力电梯，或从量子知识之塔底层出发。
answer.en: The Forge hangs below the Hanging City: raise it from the control room in the Meltwater District, then warp to the Forge District from the Brittle Hollow tower on Ash Twin (the shaft is broken). The Southern Observatory’s surface door is broken; go under the crust, either from the gravity cannon across a chain of gravity lifts or from the base of the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.

question.zh: 量子卫星的第六个位置怎么去？
question.en: How do you reach the Quantum Moon’s sixth location?

answer.zh: 要用齐三条量子法则：成像法则（深巨星量子试验之塔）、纠缠法则（余烬双星湖床洞穴）、第六位置法则（碎空星量子知识之塔：祭坛必须在卫星北极）。在祭坛里关门关灯就会随它移动，让祭坛出现在北极后再用一次，就能见到所莱内姆。
answer.en: You need all three quantum rules: imaging (Tower of Quantum Trials on Giant’s Deep), entanglement (Lakebed Cave on Ember Twin), and the sixth location (Tower of Quantum Knowledge on Brittle Hollow: the shrine must be at the moon’s north pole). Shut yourself in the shrine in the dark to travel with it; get it to the north pole and use it once more to meet Solanum.

answer.zh: 太阳站没能引爆太阳后，挪麦人去调查刚到的彗星"闯入者"。彗星核心里是高压的幽灵物质，外壳破裂后几乎一瞬间覆盖了整个星系。幽灵物质肉眼看不见，用相机能看到。
answer.en: After the Sun Station failed, the Nomai went to study a newly arrived comet, the Interloper. Its core held ghost matter under extreme pressure; when it ruptured, the ghost matter covered the solar system almost instantly. It is invisible to the eye but shows up on camera.

step.en: Put the project’s core in the Vessel, enter the coordinates, warp

step.en: Walk from the north pole to the south, drop into the crater in the quantum storm, arrive at a quantum observatory

line.en: But I think the rules are about to change.
line.zh: 不过我觉得规则就快变了。

step.en: Take the project’s core; the loop stops

step.zh: 登上量子卫星，去它的第六个位置，等超新星
step.en: Land on the Quantum Moon, go to its sixth location, wait for the supernova

line.en: HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN HERE? MINUTES? YEARS? YOU ARE UNSURE BUT IT SEEMS YOUR JOURNEY HAS REACHED ITS END.
line.zh: 你在这儿待了有多久了？几分钟？还是几年？对此你并不清楚，但你的旅途似乎已经到达了终点。

note.zh: 发售时这句结束语只显示成"813"，正好是它在游戏文本里的编号，玩家因此叫它"813 结局"，1.0.2 才修好。
note.en: At launch this ending showed only “813” — the line’s ID in the game text — so players called it the 813 ending until patch 1.0.2.

step.zh: 开飞船飞得足够远，躲过超新星
step.en: Fly far enough from the Sun to outrun the supernova

line.en: NOW BEYOND THE REACH OF THE SUPERNOVA, YOU DRIFT THROUGH SPACE UNTIL YOUR SHIP'S RESOURCES ARE FINALLY DEPLETED
line.zh: 你已经再也无法到达超新星，只能在太空中飘荡，直到宇宙飞船的资源耗尽

step.zh: 在高能实验室装上黑洞核心和白洞核心，把侦察兵射进黑洞
step.en: In the High Energy Lab, fit a black hole core and a white hole core and fire your scout into the black hole

step.zh: 侦察兵从白洞出来之后、进黑洞之前，拔掉一个核心：两个侦察兵同时存在
step.en: After it comes out of the white hole but before it goes in, pull a core: now two scouts exist

line.en: YOU DESTROYED THE FABRIC OF SPACETIME

note.zh: 片尾字幕会用卡祖笛版主题曲飞快滚完。
note.en: The credits then race by to a kazoo cover of the theme.

step.zh: 超新星爆发时，跳进灰烬双星计划中心张开的黑洞
step.en: As the supernova hits, jump into the black hole that opens at the center of the Ash Twin Project

step.zh: 下一轮计划里会多出一个你；这一轮不再跳一次，就会打破时空
step.en: Next loop another you is waiting in the project; skip the jump this time and spacetime breaks

line.en: Are you me from the last loop?
line.zh: 你是上一个循环的我自己吗？

step.zh: 雕像和你配对之前就死了，游戏从头开始
step.en: Die before the statue pairs with you, and the game starts over

step.en: Die after taking the project’s core, and you don’t wake up

use.en: Ride the lift up the launch tower

use.zh: 拿到之后，营火边才能打盹
use.en: Unlocks dozing at campfires

use.zh: 射进小种子看里面
use.en: Peek through small seeds

use.zh: 追踪器显示它同时在两个地方
use.en: Its tracker shows it in two places at once

use.zh: 相机能看到幽灵物质
use.en: Its camera sees ghost matter

use.zh: 当灯照亮化石的嘴
use.en: Light up the fossil’s mouth

from.zh: 自带旅行者频道，其他频道靠近信号源时学会
from.en: Starts with the Travelers frequency; learns others near their sources

use.zh: 旅行者频道：循着口琴声找到费尔德斯巴
use.en: Travelers: follow the harmonica to Feldspar

use.zh: 求救信号：找到第一个逃生舱后出现，带你找到3号逃生舱
use.en: Distress Beacon: appears after your first escape pod, leads to Escape Pod 3

use.zh: 量子波动：量子碎片和量子卫星
use.en: Quantum Fluctuations: shards and the Quantum Moon

use.zh: 在宇宙之眼找回旅行者们的乐器
use.en: Find the travelers’ instruments at the Eye

use.zh: 读懂挪麦人的螺旋文字和记录：几乎每条线索都靠它
use.en: Read Nomai spiral text and recordings — nearly every clue depends on it

use.zh: 关掉它，完全黑暗：和量子物体纠缠在一起
use.en: Turn it off for total darkness and you become entangled

use.zh: 在祭坛里关灯，随卫星换位置
use.en: Lights out in the shrine to move with the moon

use.zh: 在错位的重力电梯之间跳
use.en: Jump between misaligned gravity lifts

use.zh: 深巨星重力太大，高处够不着
use.en: Too weak for Giant’s Deep’s gravity on high ledges

use.zh: 关掉引擎，靠惯性滑过安康鱼
use.en: Cut the engines and drift past anglerfish

use.zh: 飞船日志记下每条线索和传闻，传闻模式里的问号就是还没去的地方
use.en: The log records every clue and rumor; the question marks in rumor mode are places you haven’t been

use.zh: 打盹快进时间，等沙子流走
use.en: Doze to skip time, e.g. until the sand drains

use.zh: 冥想直接结束这一轮：第三轮起问加布罗"你怎么能这么冷静"就能学会
use.en: Meditate to end the loop early: from the third loop, ask Gabbro how they stay so calm

use.zh: 烤棉花糖回血
use.en: Roast marshmallows to heal

use.zh: 跃迁平台：等对应天体过头顶
use.en: Warp pads: wait for the target overhead

use.zh: 重力炮：召回航天飞机
use.en: Gravity cannons: recall a shuttle

use.zh: 投影池：看到远处的场景，比如沉在海底的跟踪模块
use.en: Projection pools: see far-off places, like the sunken tracking module

said.zh: 哈尔说加布罗打算回到深巨星，对天文台的挪麦雕像作进一步的调查。
said.en: Hal says Gabbro went back to Giant’s Deep to try to learn more about the Nomai statue in the observatory.

said.zh: 听起来埃斯科依然驻扎在废岩星。他已经在那儿独自待了好一阵子了。
said.en: Sounds like Esker is still stationed on the Attlerock. They’ve been there by themself for a while.

said.zh: 我听说废岩星上有挪麦人的废墟。没人知道它们是干什么用的，也不知道挪麦人为什么要造它们。天文台里的挪麦文字提到，挪麦人正在对废岩星上的某种设备进行校准。
said.en: I hear there are Nomai ruins somewhere on the Attlerock. No one knows what they are or why they were built. The Nomai text in the observatory talks about calibrating some sort of device on the Attlerock.

said.zh: 埃斯科的信号镜日志报告说，木炉星的某处传来了口琴声。他说那声音听起来和费尔德斯巴的口琴一模一样。可是费尔德斯巴早就消失在太空里了。
said.en: Esker's signalscope log reports harmonica music coming from somewhere on Timber Hearth. They claim it sounds just like Feldspar's harmonica, but Feldspar disappeared in space ages ago.

said.zh: 埃斯科说废岩星的北极（在我的小地图上用红色标出）非常适合用信号镜去聆听其他旅行者演奏的音乐。
said.en: Esker says the Attlerock’s north pole (marked in red on my minimap) is a great spot to listen for the other travelers’ music with a signalscope.

said.zh: 切特看见一艘挪麦宇宙飞船残骸向余烬双星南半球的某个地方发射了一道光束。
said.en: Chert saw a Nomai shipwreck shooting a beam of light into the sky somewhere on Ember Twin's southern hemisphere.

said.zh: 切特觉得地表很少有废墟这个事实，说明挪麦人一定住在地下的什么地方。
said.en: Chert thinks the lack of surface ruins means the Nomai must have lived somewhere underground.

said.zh: 根据瑞拜克的说法，从地面进入天文台是不可能的（他试过了），不过地壳下某个地方可能有条通路。
said.en: Riebeck says you can't get into the observatory from the surface (they tried), but there's probably a path to it beneath the crust somewhere.

said.zh: 加布罗说水面下有一股很强劲的水流，使得水里的东西无法沉下去。
said.en: Gabbro says there’s a strong current beneath the surface of the ocean that prevents anything from sinking below it.

said.zh: 深巨星某些岛屿的海滩上有挪麦雕像，这是其中的一座。这些雕像就和加布罗带回到木炉星的那个没什么两样。雕像岛（加布罗是这么称呼它的）就在两座由天然石拱门连接的岛屿那里。
said.en: One of the islands on Giant’s Deep has a Nomai statue on the beach just like the one Gabbro brought back to Timber Hearth. Statue Island (as Gabbro calls it) is the one with two islands connected by a natural rock arch.

said.zh: 加布罗在每个循环开始时，总会在天空中看到一道明亮的闪光。深巨星的轨道上一定发生了什么事情。
said.en: Gabbro sees a bright flash in the sky at the start of every loop. Something must be happening in orbit around Giant’s Deep.

said.zh: 费尔德斯巴提示说，抵达深巨星核心的秘密就藏在他的飞船坠毁的那棵空心藤蔓尽头里。我要去安康鱼骨架的尾巴那里，在迷雾里寻找闪烁的光亮，才能发现费尔德斯巴的飞船。
said.en: Feldspar hinted that a secret to reaching the core of Giant's Deep lies at the end of the hollow vine they crashed their ship into. To find Feldspar's ship, I'll want to go to the tail end of the anglerfish skeleton and look for a flickering light in the fog.

topic_sections.scope: audited Nomai relationships and complete achievements
Echoes of the Eye: discovery routes, mechanical requirements, alternatives, historical causation and endings; no speedrun exploits or datamined codes.
